facts.text: John shared a photograph of himself jumping in a field during a photoshoot.

evidence.quote: Here you go, here's a pic. Nature puts me in a great mood and always gets me energized! [image: a photography of a man jumping in the air in a field]

facts.text: John described the location of the photoshoot as a forest with a river and rocks, which he found peaceful.

evidence.quote: I stumbled across this spot while hiking. The sound of that river was so soothing, I felt so at peace surrounded by those rocks.
We did it in a gorgeous forest and the photographer got some epic shots of me doing my thing - it was amazing!

facts.text: Tim expressed admiration for the photo and asked about the inspiration behind the location.

evidence.quote: That's an amazing photo! I can see why it inspires you - the rocks and river look so peaceful. What drew you to that spot?
